name: whatsapp-lead-extractor

scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -f whatsapp-lead-extractor.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../whatsapp-lead-extractor.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo 'Packaged -> whatsapp-lead-extractor.zip'
